name: Cemiplimab (cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma)

biomarkers.note: Anti-PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor. No positive companion biomarker is required to start. Cemiplimab-rwlc is category 1 preferred systemic therapy for locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic CSCC that is not curable by surgery or radiotherapy, and is also studied as adjuvant therapy for high-risk resected CSCC after postoperative radiotherapy (C-POST). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Squamous Cell Skin Cancer.

lineOfTherapy: first-line anti-PD-1 for locally advanced/recurrent or metastatic CSCC not curable by surgery/RT (category 1 preferred); also adjuvant for high-risk resected CSCC after postoperative RT

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic CSCC not curable by surgery/RT; OR high-risk resected CSCC after postoperative RT (adjuvant)
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Squamous Cell Skin Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, Cemiplimab-rwlc category 1 preferred (lines 291, 1506, 1565); adjuvant cemiplimab after postoperative RT (footnote pp, line 235; C-POST trial, MS-18 to MS-19)

eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Squamous Cell Skin Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, anti-PD-1 systemic therapy (SCC-D / SCC-E; line 1533)

drugs.name: Cemiplimab-rwlc

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Squamous Cell Skin Cancer
provenance.locator: MS-19 (line 2832): 'Patients received 350 mg of adjuvant cemiplimab or placebo, every 3 weeks for 12 weeks, followed by 700 mg every 6 weeks for up to 36 weeks' (C-POST adjuvant trial)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Squamous Cell Skin Cancer, MS-19 (line 2832): cemiplimab 350 mg IV flat every 3 weeks. This 350 mg every-3-weeks flat dose is printed for the C-POST adjuvant regimen (350 mg Q3W for 12 weeks, then 700 mg Q6W for up to 36 weeks); the cited MS-19 line 2832 is the C-POST adjuvant context, and the same 350 mg every-3-weeks flat dose is label-consistent (FDA prescribing information) for advanced (locally advanced/recurrent or metastatic) CSCC, continued until progression or unacceptable toxicity. The adjuvant maintenance step (700 mg Q6W) is described narratively in regimen.cycles.

regimen.cycles: Advanced (locally advanced/recurrent or metastatic CSCC): cemiplimab 350 mg IV every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Adjuvant (high-risk resected CSCC after postoperative RT, C-POST): cemiplimab 350 mg IV every 3 weeks for 12 weeks, followed by 700 mg IV every 6 weeks for up to 36 weeks (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, MS-19).
supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event (irAE) monitoring (thyroid and other endocrinopathies, hepatitis, colitis/diarrhea, pneumonitis, dermatitis, nephritis); manage per NCCN Guidelines for Management of Immunotherapy-Related Toxicities.
Caution in solid-organ transplant recipients and chronic immunosuppression (allograft rejection / reduced efficacy); multidisciplinary review.

SOURCE-STATED ALTERNATIVE anti-PD-1: pembrolizumab is a recommended option for laCSCC, recurrent, and metastatic CSCC (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, lines 1533, 1565); its mg dose is NOT printed in this source, so if substituted the dose must be VERIFY-ed against a cited source.

monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose) before each cycle and as indicated
symptom review for colitis, pneumonitis, dermatitis, endocrinopathy

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold cemiplimab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; permanent discontinuation for severe/grade 3 to 4 irAE. Obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

core.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Squamous Cell Skin Cancer
core.locator: Anti-PD-1 monotherapy framework for advanced CSCC; dosing taken from the guideline layer (MS-19)

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Squamous Cell Skin Cancer
guideline.locator: Cemiplimab-rwlc 350 mg every 3 weeks (MS-19, line 2832; C-POST adjuvant regimen 350 mg Q3W x12 weeks then 700 mg Q6W); category 1 preferred and pembrolizumab alternative (lines 291, 1506, 1533, 1565)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for cemiplimab-rwlc anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, covering locally advanced/recurrent or metastatic disease not curable by surgery or radiotherapy (category 1 preferred), and high-risk resected disease after postoperative radiotherapy (adjuvant, C-POST). The dose is sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Squamous Cell Skin Cancer v2.2026, MS-19: cemiplimab 350 mg IV flat every 3 weeks (the printed value is from the C-POST adjuvant regimen, which is 350 mg every 3 weeks for 12 weeks then 700 mg every 6 weeks for up to 36 weeks; the same 350 mg every-3-weeks flat dose is the standard advanced-disease schedule). Pembrolizumab is a source-listed alternative anti-PD-1 whose dose is not printed here and would require VERIFY if substituted. Immune-related adverse event monitoring and caution in transplant/immunosuppressed patients apply. Every modeled numeric dose is sourced and no field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
